arxiv-1806-09884.title: On Guay’s evaluation map for affine Yangians
arxiv-1806-09884.creator: Ryosuke Kodera
arxiv-1806-09884.description: Abstract We give a detailed proof of the existence of evaluation map for affine Yangians of type A to clarify that it needs an assumption on parameters. This map was first found by Guay but a proof of its well-definedness and the assumption have not been written down in the literature.

arxiv-2111-13537.title: A model of semantic completion in generative episodic memory
arxiv-2111-13537.creator: Zahra Fayyaz, Aya Altamimi, Sen Cheng, Laurenz Wiskott 1 Institute for Neural Computation, Ruhr University Bochum, Germany * laurenz.wiskott@rub.de
arxiv-2111-13537.description: Abstract Many different studies have suggested that episodic memory is a generative process, but most computational models adopt a storage view. In this work, we propose a computational model for generative episodic memory. It is based on the central hypothesis that the hippocampus stores and retrieves selected aspects of an episode as a memory trace, which is necessarily incomplete.

arxiv-2310-18438.title: Exploring Shape Embedding for Cloth-Changing Person Re-Identification via 2D-3D Correspondences Conference: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 29-November 3, 2023; Ottawa, ON, Canada Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’23),
arxiv-2310-18438.creator: Yubin Wang, Huimin Yu, Yuming Yan, Shuyi Song, Biyang Liu, Yichong Lu
arxiv-2310-18438.description: Abstract . Cloth-Changing Person Re-Identification (CC-ReID) is a common and realistic problem since fashion constantly changes over time and people’s aesthetic preferences are not set in stone. While most existing cloth-changing ReID methods focus on learning cloth-agnostic identity representations from coarse semantic cues (e.g. silhouettes and part segmentation maps), they neglect the continuous shape distributions at the pixel level.

arxiv-2311-18817.title: Dichotomy of Early and Late Phase Implicit Biases Can Provably Induce Grokking
arxiv-2311-18817.creator: Kaifeng Lyu, Jikai Jin, Zhiyuan Li, Simon S. Du, Jason D. Lee, Wei Hu
arxiv-2311-18817.description: Abstract Recent work by Power et al. 2022 highlighted a surprising “grokking” phenomenon in learning arithmetic tasks: a neural net first “memorizes” the training set, resulting in perfect training accuracy but near-random test accuracy, and after training for sufficiently longer, it suddenly transitions to perfect test accuracy.

arxiv-2403-00403.title: Fractal interpolation in the context of prediction accuracy optimization
arxiv-2403-00403.creator: Alexandra Băicoianu, Cristina Gabriela Gavrilă, Cristina Maria Pacurar, Victor Dan Pacurar
arxiv-2403-00403.description: Abstract This paper focuses on the hypothesis of optimizing time series predictions using fractal interpolation techniques. In general, the accuracy of machine learning model predictions is closely related to the quality and quantitative aspects of the data used, following the principle of garbage-in, garbage-out .

arxiv-2409-04575.description: Abstract Context. They fill an important gap in our understanding of star formation. Aims.

arxiv-2411-09315.title: Sustainable Hardware Specialization Thanks: *Equal Contribution
arxiv-2411-09315.creator: *Pranav Dangi † , *Thilini Kaushalya Bandara † , Saeideh Sheikhpour ‡, Tulika Mitra † and Lieven Eeckhout ‡
arxiv-2411-09315.description: Abstract . Hardware specialization is commonly viewed as a way to scale performance in the dark silicon era with modern-day SoCs featuring multiple tens of dedicated accelerators. By only powering on hardware circuitry when needed, accelerators fundamentally trade off chip area for power efficiency. Dark silicon however comes with a severe downside, namely its environmental footprint.

arxiv-2505-15572.title: Bridging the Domain Gap in Equation Distillation with Reinforcement Feedback
arxiv-2505-15572.creator: Wangyang Ying, Haoyue Bai, Nanxu Gong, Xinyuan Wang, Sixun Dong, Haifeng Chen, Yanjie Fu
arxiv-2505-15572.description: Abstract The data-to-equation (Data2Eqn) task aims to discover interpretable mathematical equations that map observed values ( 𝐗 \mathbf{X} ) to labels ( y y ), offering physical insights and broad applicability across academic and industrial domains. Genetic programming and traditional deep learning-based approaches suffer from search inefficiency and poor generalization on small task-specific datasets.

He graduated at Harvard in 1777, read law at Newburyport, Mass., with Theophilus Parsons, and was admitted to the bar in 1780. pmc-12649762.title: Recent COVID-19 Infection Increases Complication Risk After Body-Contouring Surgery
pmc-12649762.creator: Matthew Q Dao, Diana Shaari, Abigail R Tirrell, Brooke Barrow, Sheuli Chowdhury, Bernice Z Yu, Paul Won, BaiJing Qin, Peter J Taub, Peter W Henderson
pmc-12649762.description: BackgroundAlthough COVID-19 infection rates have declined from pandemic peaks, recent infection may pose a potential concern in aesthetic surgery. Previous studies, constrained by small cohorts and early-pandemic data, have not conclusively established whether recent COVID-19 infection continues to influence surgical outcomes.

pmc-12741105.title: Challenges in neuropsychological improvement after shunt surgery for idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus
pmc-12741105.creator: Ondřej Rýdlo, Adéla Bubeníková, Petr Skalický, Klára Häcklová, Robért Leško, Aleš Vlasák, Hana Georgi, Ondřej Bradáč
pmc-12741105.description: ObjectivesTo evaluate cognitive and mood changes 3 months after shunting for idiopathic normal-pressure hydrocephalus (iNPH), and compare postoperative outcomes with matched healthy controls across cognitive domains.MethodsThirty-three iNPH patients underwent neuropsychological testing preoperatively and at 3 months; 71 age-, sex-, and education-matched controls were assessed once. Tests were grouped into six cognitive domains.

pmc-13071865.title: Clinical Efficacy and Safety of Intramuscular Injections of Autologous Total IgG in Patients With Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria: An Open‐Label Prospective Pilot Trial
pmc-13071865.creator: Young‐Min Ye, Myung‐Eun Kim, Byul Kwon, Dong‐Ho Nahm
pmc-13071865.description: Chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) remains challenging to manage in patients who do not respond adequately to antihistamines or currently available immunomodulatory therapies. Intramuscular injection of autologous total IgG (autologous immunoglobulin therapy: AIGT) has demonstrated clinical efficacy, safety and immunomodulatory effects in patients with moderate‐to‐severe atopic dermatitis in a randomized placebo‐controlled clinical trial.

pmc-13374166.creator: Qianqian Ji, Fangyi Zhang, Xinyi Zhao, Kang Feng, Mengyao Zhang, Ying Hong
pmc-13374166.description: IntroductionNeovascular glaucoma (NVG) is a severe, vision-threatening secondary glaucoma. This study investigate the demographic characteristics and medical costs of NVG in a tertiary medical center in China.

pmc-13571170.creator: G Kourakos, H Morel‐Seytoux, E C Dogrul, T Kadir, H E Dahlke
pmc-13571170.description: Climate change and human activities increasingly affect interconnected stream–aquifer systems, motivating continued evaluation of how stream–aquifer interactions are represented in integrated groundwater–surface water models. Most groundwater models quantify stream–aquifer exchange using an empirical riverbed leakance parameter that is predefined or calibrated from observed head differences between the stream and aquifer.

pmc-13613067.title: Linking the second messenger cyclic di-GMP signaling with the regulatory activity of the small RNA ErsA in Pseudomonas aeruginosa
pmc-13613067.creator: Silvia Ferrara, Tarcisio Brignoli, Silvia Santoro, Eloise Mastrangelo, Giovanni Bertoni
pmc-13613067.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Biofilm formation in Pseudomonas aeruginosa is regulated by intersecting signals from the envelope stress response and the cyclic di-GMP (c-di-GMP) second messenger network. We previously described that the envelope stress response sigma factor σ22 can simultaneously drive transcriptional activation and, via the small RNA ErsA, post-transcriptional repression of algC, which encodes a central enzyme in the production of sugar precursors for biofilm matrix exopolysaccharides.
